title: Elizondo worked with Grusch in a SCIF

tellings.quote: I I worked with the guy I can't say where I've been asked not to say where we both worked in a skift together he had every access that you needed to have and he saw the same information I did

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, says he worked side by side with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who later came forward as a UFO whistleblower, inside a SCIF, a sealed room for handling classified material. Elizondo says he was asked not to say where, but that Grusch "had every access that you needed to have and he saw the same information I did." He tells it to back up Grusch's account with his own.
